eligibility.advisoryBoundary: UI uses projection-derived advisory eligibility; it never authorizes a command

supported: explicit server-bound SBA outcome reported by the projected priority recipient

outcomes.unavailable: disabled or unavailable control makes no attempt and shows a reason
outcomes.accepted: sender receives an accepted receipt and both seats observe the accepted revision and the same next-incarnation stack object for the cast physical card
outcomes.rejected: sender receives a rejection and shared state does not change
outcomes.failed: missing or divergent shared stack evidence, automatic stable-SBA assumption, or an unreachable SBA window fails the journey

sameSlice: Manual overlay cast selector/button and obsolete cast-surface expectations
retained: Manual fallback for unsupported card semantics

positive: explicit no-SBA tabletop confirmation advances the Core lifecycle before cast
both seats show the same next-incarnation top stack object for the cast physical card
negative: SBA outcome from the wrong actor, wrong window, active HOLD, or stale revision is rejected without state change
